correctness.rationale: The proof partitions all dyadic inputs into four valuation classes and computes exact \(F_2\) images by three odd-linear/even-quadratic bijections. Exact image propagation follows from the isometric polynomial map \(u\mapsto au+bu^2\) for odd \(a\) and even \(b\). The \(c_r\) center-gap valuation inductively equals \(2r+2\); this certifies the even balls split exactly at precision \(2r+3\), making the all-\(k\) image cardinality exact. Complete direct images agree for 136 independent \((r,k)\) grids through modulus \(2^{18}\); these finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof. Boundary cases \(k=1\), \(k=2r+2\) and \(k=2r+3\) are checked symbolically.

value.rationale: The dyadic images of iterated Chebyshev doubling form a natural infinite arithmetic-dynamics family. The exact three-ball decomposition is a complete image-set classification for every iterate and every modulus, not a routine small computation. A nontrivial center-valuation threshold \(2r+2\) causes two even branches to merge at coarse precision and split at deeper precision. Exact finite-level cardinalities, stabilized image densities and the two-point limiting attractor follow; these structural data motivate future fiber and perturbation studies. It does not claim a general theorem for all Dickson indices.
